From the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md), audit tree 0c7d60a.

**GAP-1** (G-1, Major, new): The arrangement is outside every slot lint and simulation
- Evidence: schedule.py:189-208, schedule.py:166 (own _rng); audit.py:357,501,537 read slot.py and slot_for_day calls only; M1c survived
- What would close it: Lint schedule.arrange like the slot path (no bank, used or ledger reads; no draw but slot_for_day) and run the attendee simulation over arrange's output positions

Held: an audit's findings are the client's to release. Read the gap's section in the audit report before planning; re-verify on the current main.
data.title: The arrangement is outside every slot lint and simulation

data.body: Re-verified on main 58bb75d (2026-10-12), 166 commits after the audit tree 0c7d60a. PARTLY ADDRESSED, still open. Closed half: the position tell now runs schedule.arrange on synthetic nights and reads the wall's order (commit 4ac7ce3; audit.py:10, tell_pool(questions, arrange); test_audit.py:614-643 'the command line measures the real arrangement'), and arrange itself raises if the arranged answer is not at slot_for_day(day) (schedule.py:209-210). Open half: no static lint covers arrange. slot_path_violations runs over slot.py only; slot_call_violations/ledger_violations check calls of slot_for_day, not arrange's inputs. arrange still uses its own _rng (schedule.py:169) for the distractor shuffle. Remaining work: lint arrange like the slot path (no bank, used or ledger reads; no draw for the answer but slot_for_day). Re-run mutant M1c to confirm.
